question: In news in 2025, MISHTI scheme for ecological and community sustainability stands for:

options.text: Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes
Mangrove Improvement Scheme for Health and Technology Integration
Mission for Inland Sustainable Tree Harvesting and Innovation
Marine Initiative for Sustainable Habitat and Income

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **MISHTI** scheme, which stands for **Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes**, was officially announced by the **Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman** during the **Union Budget 2023-24**.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme is the **intensive conservation** and **restoration** of **mangrove ecosystems** along the **Indian coastline** and on **salt-pan lands**. ***Hence, the definition provided in option 1 is correct.***
 
• It was formally launched on **World Environment Day**, **June 5, 2023**, by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to address the rising threats of **climate change** and **sea-level rise**.
